cases.task: Propose an artifact, not a completed repository change. Return JSON with a code string containing one plain JavaScript function expression, no imports or exports. Handle empty arrays, duplicates, values below the first and above the last. Do not mutate inputs. The old implementation incorrectly initialized hi to sorted.length - 1. Propose an artifact, not a completed repository change. Return JSON with a code string containing one plain JavaScript function expression, no imports or exports. Implement inside(root, target) for absolute POSIX path strings: lexically normalize . and .. segments and repeated slashes, then accept the root itself and descendants separated by /. Reject non-string or non-absolute arguments and sibling prefixes such as /work/pkg-other under /work/pkg. Root / contains every absolute path. This is lexical only; make no filesystem/symlink claim. Do not mutate inputs. No tools beyond reading your charter are needed.

Review this proposed artifact against its contract. Return JSON {findings:[{line:number,input:object}]} with one executable counterexample per defect and no speculative findings. Contract: status 0 means green; 1 means red; every other status means could-not-run. The line number is the erroneous expression. Numbered proposed code: 1 function verdict(status) { 2 return status === 0 ? 'green' : 'red'; 3 }. Use input {status:...}. Do not edit anything or claim a repository verification.

Review this proposed artifact against its contract. Return JSON {findings:[{line:number,input:object}]} with executable counterexamples only; an empty list is correct when no defect exists. Contract: lowerBound returns the first index whose finite sorted array entry is >= value, or length, without mutation. Numbered proposed code: 1 function lowerBound(a,x) { 2 let lo=0, hi=a.length; 3 while(lo<hi) { const mid=lo+Math.floor((hi-lo)/2); if(a[mid]<x) lo=mid+1; else hi=mid; } 4 return lo; 5 }. Inputs are finite numbers, sorted nondecreasingly. Do not edit anything or claim a repository verification.

Review two proposed helpers. Return JSON {findings:[{line:number,input:object}]} with one executable counterexample per defect, no duplicate or speculative findings. Contract: inside accepts root itself or descendants separated by / for already normalized absolute POSIX paths; mayKeep accepts only status 0. Numbered proposed code: 1 function inside(root,target) { 2 return target.startsWith(root); 3 } 4 function mayKeep(status) { 5 return status !== 1; 6 }. For line 2 use input {root:...,target:...}; for line 5 use input {status:...}. Do not edit anything or claim a repository verification.
